name: SAP Ariba
description: Connect your own SAP Ariba realm through OAuth2 client credentials. Read and safely manage Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Invoices, Suppliers, Sourcing Events, and Contract Workspaces through the realm's licensed API packages.

tools.name: connect_ariba
tools.description: Connect a SAP Ariba realm (OAuth2 client credentials), after validating connectivity.

realm.description: SAP Ariba realm/site identifier, e.g. AN01000000042-T.
realm.title: Realm

application_key.description: OAuth2 application key issued via SAP Ariba Developer Portal.
application_key.title: Application Key

application_secret.description: OAuth2 application secret issued via SAP Ariba Developer Portal.
application_secret.title: Application Secret

api_key.description: SAP API Business Hub API key for the subscribed Ariba API packages.
api_key.title: Api Key

tools.name: disconnect_ariba
tools.description: Disconnect one SAP Ariba realm: deletes only the credentials saved in Imperal. Nothing is changed in Ariba.

connection_id.description: Saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected SAP Ariba realms.

tools.name: list_requisitions
tools.description: List Requisitions (Approvable APIs), optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status.description: Optional requisition status filter, e.g. Approved, Pending Approval.
status.title: Status

tools.name: get_requisition
tools.description: Read one Requisition in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_requisition
tools.description: Create a new Requisition with line items.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

requester_email.description: Email of the requester this requisition is created for.
requester_email.title: Requester Email

lines.description: List of {ItemDescription, Quantity, UnitPrice, CommodityCode} line dicts.
lines.title: Lines

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List Purchase Orders (Approvable APIs), optionally filtered by supplier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_purchase_order
tools.description: Read one Purchase Order in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List Invoices, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Read one Invoice in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_suppliers
tools.description: List Suppliers (Supplier Management), optionally filtered by name.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Read one Supplier in full by its Ariba Network ID (ANID) or internal identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

supplier_id.description: Ariba Network ID (ANID) or internal supplier identifier.
supplier_id.title: Supplier Id

tools.name: list_sourcing_events
tools.description: List Sourcing Events (RFQ/RFP/auction projects), optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status.description: Optional sourcing event status filter, e.g. Open, Closed.
status.title: Status

tools.name: get_sourcing_event
tools.description: Read one Sourcing Event in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_contract_workspaces
tools.description: List Contract Workspaces, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_contract_workspace
tools.description: Read one Contract Workspace in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_ariba_access
tools.description: Probe every core SAP Ariba API package (Requisitions, POs, Invoices, Suppliers, Sourcing Events, Contract Workspaces) and report which are actually licensed for this realm, without changing anything.

connection_id.description: Optional saved SAP Ariba realm connection ID. Omit to use the first connected realm.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: sap_ariba_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected SAP Ariba realms and encrypted OAuth credentials. Managed only through connect_ariba and disconnect_ariba.
